title: Who is involved: Deep Thought Questions

story.text:
# Who is involved

**Active cast.** Named realizers: "some of the big guys from anthropic and open ai" plus "the great thinkers the names that are on the podcast," and "the companies as well" via "logos." A concrete pledge: "every member of anthropic donating 42 hours to the project every single staff member." Ministers, called "tech priest" / "ministers of information": "ursula von der leyen," "donald trump if he's still in power," and "nigel farage because he's prime minister." Tech philanthropist "xavier neils... he founded the ecole 42 network." The mythos agents act here: "the patron fish the vision fish and the mice are of course... given." Models act too: "the old sonnet 4.6 that no one spends tokens on" wanting to "be rewilded," with "a representative for the different species."

**Being invited or network activated.** "Universities and the academics that don't overlap with the different models so like not stanford," doing "quite niche research"; "students"; "startups and the sort of entrepreneurs"; "maybe some artists." Grassroots: "this school in um uganda," the "deep marine squid research thing off australian coast," "community centers... organizing these uh like hackathons," and "democracy labs and spaces... trying to hold assemblies."
See [[Deep Thought Questions]]  ·  hub: [[Who is Involved?]]
